I build and validate quantitative models for credit risk and systematic
equity research. My work covers PD/LGD/EAD frameworks and Basel III capital,
derivatives pricing under stochastic volatility, and NLP-driven signals
built from unstructured financial text.

I hold a PhD in Computational Statistical Physics from the University of
Houston, where I developed algorithms for finding structure in large, noisy,
high-dimensional systems and built uncertainty quantification methods using
extreme value theory. The same problems recur in finance: estimating things
from data that is messy, non-stationary, and short on ground truth.

I am currently looking for quantitative research, model validation, and
model risk roles.
